description: Meetlocaties Verkeer in Zeeland is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Op deze kaart zijn alle meetpunten van Provincie Zeeland te zien. De meetpunten bestaan uit het gladheidsmeetnet, motorvoertuigtelpunten (verkeerstellingen), snelheidsmeetpunten, fietstelpunten en landbouwtelpunten. In de dataset staat meer informatie over de data, zoals de meetwijze, energievoorziening, locatieomschrijving en meer. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are meetpunten, verkeerslussen, vervoersnetwerken. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
